_about: Batch B6b (Engram and the vision path). Owner: B6b writer.

n-gram.short: A run of n tokens that follow each other in the text. For example, the last 2 tokens are a 2-gram and the last 3 tokens are a 3-gram.

engram.short: An optional model part. It hashes the recent n-grams of each token into large learned tables. A projection and a gate then mix the rows it finds into the hidden states.
engram.long: Only the layers in engram_layer_ids have it ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/models/decoder_layer.py:80-83}}).

hash.short: A function that turns a key (here an n-gram of token ids) into a number in a fixed range. Different keys can give the same number (a collision).

compressed-tokenizer.short: Engram's lookup table that maps each token id to a smaller id. Tokens with the same normalized text, for example "Hello" and " hello", get the same id.

enp-group.short: The Engram-parallel process group. Its ranks split each Engram table into equal parts and read rows from each other.
enp-group.long: Its size is engram_parallel_size; 0 means the size of the whole world (CP × DP) ({{cite deepinfer/config.py:172-173}}).

vision-encoder.short: The model part that turns an image into vectors that the language model can read. In DeepInfer it is a ViT plus a projector.

vit.short: Vision Transformer. It cuts an image into small square patches and runs transformer blocks over the patches, as an LLM does over tokens.
vit.long: DeepInfer's ViT has 32 blocks of width 1024 ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/models/vision_encoder/vit.py:26-31}}).

image-patch.short: A small square of an image, 14 x 14 pixels in DeepInfer. The ViT treats each patch as one input row.

vl-projector.short: The small MLP after the ViT. The downsample step first joins each r x r block of patch vectors (r comes from config.json). The projector maps the result to the hidden size of the LLM.

image-token.short: A prompt position that belongs to an image. It gets an image vector or a learned marker vector instead of a text embedding. In the prompt, the first image token has id vocab_size + 2 and all others vocab_size + 1.
image-token.long: The offsets 0, 3 and 4 (START, NEW_LINE, END) are not used in prompt ids; the row types come from mm_token_type ({{cite deepinfer/ve/multimodal_processor.py:146-147}}, {{cite deepinfer/multimodal_tokens.py:17-28}}).

multimodal-processor.short: The engine helper that expands image placeholders and sends each request to a forked worker process. The worker prepares the image data.

multimodal-pool.short: A shared, pinned host-memory pool. The multimodal worker puts its tensors there, so the engine process gets them without a copy through the queue.
